summary: Read one runtime by id without reducing every runtime

replay.detail: Existing claims and projections are read unchanged. No replay is required.

schema.detail: Add a local SQLite index on observed runtime ids and owner subjects. The index is created automatically when the store opens. Replicated claims are unchanged.

rules.detail: Runtime detail and control resolve candidate owners by indexed runtime id, then use the existing canonical status reduction at the requested snapshot. Detail reads run on a blocking worker.

compatibility.detail: Runtime resources, unknown-id responses, history and authorization semantics are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond the ordinary restart. Initial index creation reads retained runtime observations.

recovery.detail: Older binaries can read the unchanged claims without recovery.
